reasons.plausibility: The proposed mechanism aligns well with known principles of grain-boundary and dislocation strengthening in high-entropy alloys, although the specific balance of FCC/BCC phases and the exact role of Ti and resultant density might warrant further validation.
reasons.testability: They outline a clear experimental plan (varying milling times, sintering temperatures, and comparing with a cast baseline) and well-defined benchmarks (hardness, strength, densification, microstructure) that can definitively validate or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis provides a practical route (mechanical alloying + SPS) to improve the mechanical properties of CoCrFeNiTi by controlling grain refinement and phase composition, offering an actionable research direction to address the specific problem of low hardness and strength.
